subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Habari RECIPIENT_NAME,
Nafuatilia barua yangu kuhusu kupanua makundi ya walipaji kwa {Brand} kama tunavyofanya kwa michezo ya mkakati Whiteout Survival na Last War: Survival. Jambo moja linalostahili kurudiwa: tunaboresha kuelekea ubadilishaji wa kwanza wa mlipaji kwa zabuni inayotegemea thamani na pLTV, hivyo bajeti inafuata usakinishaji unaolipa mwishowe badala ya kutawanyika kwa usakinishaji wa bei rahisi. Kwa kiwango kamili tunaendesha usakinishaji 30,000 kwa siku kwenye kundi la walipaji. Nikikutumia mtazamo wa makundi kwa aina ya mchezo wako, je, ungeupima?
angle: warm bump, restate payer-conversion proof (value-based bidding to first payer)
illustrative_flags: usakinishaji 30,000 kwa siku kwenye kundi la walipaji (MobUpps-specific illustrative placeholder; Tier-3 truth-sheet band 28,000/day for gaming_midcore_hardcore/ua; not an audited result)
register_notes: Stage 1 sw Kenya gaming midcore/hardcore: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single payer-conversion proof (value-based bidding + pLTV to first payer) from parent; one illustrative MobUpps figure (30,000 installs/day on payer cohort); acronyms pLTV kept Latin, brand/game proper nouns kept; soft collaborative CTA; one question mark; no sign-off; no em-dash; no 'X, not Y' comma-negation; no hedge before figure.
